A little setup, then you are ready to share.
Choose where received files will go and review a few optional settings. Camera and nearby device access will be requested when you use those features.
Add a name and photo for nearby sharing. You can skip this and edit your profile from the top right of Home. Until then, your device name will be used.
Allow notifications for transfer progress and incoming file requests when sharing is available.
Notifications are optional. You can continue without them.
Notifications are off. You can enable them in system settings or skip this step.
Android manages background activity. Reviewing battery settings can help with long transfers when sharing is available.
Battery optimization is already disabled for Nuvyro.
This step is optional. In battery optimization settings, find Nuvyro to review its limits. Device-specific restrictions may still apply.
Choose a folder for received files. Nuvyro only needs access to the folder you select.
You can create a Nuvyro folder inside Documents. Android may not allow selecting storage roots or the Downloads folder itself.
